title: langxyne API definition (*.adef.toml)
description: The shape of an langxyne definition: admissible keys, types and required properties, spelled the one way. Checked at load by the langxyne loader where jsonschema is installed and --no-schema is not given, and the source of editor completion, hover and key diagnostics. Shape only: the loader is the authority on every rule, shape and semantics (name uniqueness, value ranges by base type, references between items, constructor and destructor shape, running sums) alike. The version is the vN in $id; bump it when admissible shape changes.

_general.description: Describes no item: the API's name, namespace, version and bound library. Required.

_name.description: An identifier, required; names every output.

_namespace.description: An identifier; the prefix for everything generated.

_version.description: Four integers 0..255, encoded most-significant first into one 32-bit value.

_bound_library.description: The library's name, not a file name: `xy`, which the Lua module loads and the Rust binding links as each platform names its file (`libxy.so`, `libxy.dylib`, `xy.dll`). ASCII letters, digits, `_` and `-`, not beginning with `-` or `lib`.

_wrapped_api.description: The wrapped API: its C headers, which the implementation includes, and the constants of this API pinned to those headers' macros.

_headers.description: Required: a non-empty list of the wrapped API's header paths, each relative to the project directory.

_pinned_value.description: Maps each untyped_bit_const key to the macro of the wrapped API's headers it must equal.

untyped_bit_const.description: Groups of constants that are bit flags: each entry a bit index or a sum of earlier entries and literals.

untyped_const.description: Groups of plain integer constants: each entry an integer or a sum of earlier entries and literals.

typed_const.description: Groups of enumerations, each item an enum whose entries are integers.

opaque_ref.description: Groups of handle types, each item a handle whose representation is the implementation's secret.

boxed_scalar.description: Groups of boxed scalars, each item a distinct kind of integer.

struct.description: Groups of structs, each item's fields in document order.

union.description: Groups of tagged unions, each item's members in document order: every member struct begins with one prefix struct whose first field is the tag and whose first field after it not u8 is the record's byte length.

callback.description: Groups of callback types, each item's parameters in document order. A function's parameter of a callback type, by value, is a callback the library calls only during that call and on its thread.

function.description: Groups of functions, each item's parameters in document order.

propertiesOnly.description: A table whose every key is a property: a group, enum or struct with no members, which the loader refuses as having no entries.

docstring.description: Documents the group, item or entry it is on; no line break, '*/' or ']]'.

baseType.description: The fixed-width type of an enum or of a group's constants: "i32" (the default) or "u32".

toString.description: Asks for a function converting a value to text, named by this identifier; absent, no conversion is generated.

format.description: How the number is spelled where a literal is emitted: "hex" or "dec" (the default).

typeName.description: A builtin type (i8, u8, i16, u16, i32, u32, i64, u64, f32, f64, memory, text) or a name from typed_const, opaque_ref, boxed_scalar, struct, union or callback. text, an offset and length into a byte arena, is a struct field type only; a union is a parameter type only, a sequence with _ref = "in" and _count.

sum.description: Terms summed into the value, in the order written: each an earlier entry's name or a literal integer written as a string ("4", "-4", "0x1f").

_value.description: The constant's value: an integer (a bit index in untyped_bit_const) or a list of terms summed.
The string; no '"', '\' or control character.
The entry's value, an integer fitting the enum's base type.

_class.description: The object's name in bindings with object semantics, a lowercase identifier; default the ref's name.

_ctor.description: The function that produces the handle: it has exactly one parameter of this type with _ref = "out".

_dtor.description: The function that releases the handle: its only parameter is this type by value; requires _ctor.

_hides_pointer.description: true where the handle is a raw pointer the library does not validate, so a dynamic-language binding wraps the lifetime of an object with a _dtor itself; default false.

_base_type.description: Required: the type of the one value the box holds, any integer type i8 through u64.

_tag.description: Required: the untyped_const entry the prefix's tag field holds for this member.

_type.description: Required: the member's struct, defined before the union, beginning with the union's prefix.

_mixed_type_list.description: true: the members lie in a list back to back, each by its own size, which a parameter of the union with _count is; default false.

_ref.description: How the callee reaches the parameter: "in" is read, "out" is written, "inout" is both; absent, by value. A memory parameter requires it.

_count.description: Makes the parameter a buffer, and is the type of its count: a memory parameter's byte count, required there; on a union, a sequence of its members, with _ref = "in", counted in members and with a byte extent of the same type; on any other type, an array of that type, with _ref = "in" or "out", counted in elements.

_optional.description: true: the caller may pass null instead of a value; only with _ref, and on a buffer only with _ref = "in".

_wrote_needed.description: true, on an "out" buffer only: the callee also reports, each of the _count type, how much it wrote and how much the whole result needs.

_return.description: Required: a typed_const enum name whose entries include the value 0.

_stack_mb.description: An untyped_const entry with a positive value: the stack, in MiB, a call needs on the caller's thread where the library runs it there.

_ref.description: "in" with _count: a view the library passes, read-only and valid for that call of the callback only; absent, by value.

_count.description: Makes the parameter a view, and is the type of its count: bytes for memory, members for a union's sequence, which adds a byte extent of the same type, else elements of its type.

_return.description: Required: a typed_const enum name whose zero entry continues and whose first non-zero entry stops.
